children: Broad Arrow Auctions, driven by Hagerty
, has released official results for its 2026
, the auction house’s second annual sale as the
official auction partner of Concours at Wynn Las Vegas
. Held October 31 at Wynn Las Vegas against the vibrant backdrop of the Strip, the single-day auction was a noteworthy success, achieving
$92.8 million in total sales with 76 percent of all lots sold (64 of 84 lots).
Broad Arrow’s 2026 Las Vegas sale now stands as the highest grossing collector car auction ever held in Las Vegas.
“We are thrilled with the results from our second annual Las Vegas Auction,” says
Barney Ruprecht, VP of Auctions for Broad Arrow

. “This catalog represented one of our most significant and most exciting offerings to date, and the total stands as one of Broad Arrow’s highest grossing sales since our first auction in 2022. The record-setting supercars and hypercars on offer were perfectly matched to the assembly on the concours lawn, and the results have aided in solidifying Las Vegas as an emerging powerhouse on the collector car auction calendar. We look forward to continuing the momentum in Zürich next weekend as we close out our 2026 live auction calendar.”

The single-day Las Vegas Auction, taken by Broad Arrow Auctioneer, Thomas Forrester, saw a standing-room-only sale from start to finish, fueled by a 63 percent increase in registered bidders over 2025, with 35 percent bidding with Broad Arrow for the very first time. No less than 10 new world record auction prices were set on the day, led by outstanding prices for the exceptional lineup of highly desirable Ferrari supercars and hypercars on offer. Complete results from Broad Arrow’s 2026 Las Vegas Auction are available at broadarrowauctions.com.

Later this week, on November 7, Broad Arrow’s 2026 live auction calendar comes to a close with its second annual Zürich Auction in partnership with Auto Zürich. Featuring more than 80 of the world’s most desirable collector cars along with a selection of sought-after memorabilia items, the auction takes place at The Dolder Grand, the iconic five-star hotel overlooking the Lake of Zürich, providing an unforgettable setting for buyers and consignors alike.
Broad Arrow’s final online sale of the year is
Global Icons: Winter Memorabilia and Artwork Online.

The two-day online auction will feature more than 300 carefully curated lots, offering collectors the opportunity to acquire rare and evocative pieces that capture the spirit, history, and artistry of motorsport. Registration is open now and bidding is live from November 9, ending on November 22 and 23.

Broad Arrow is currently inviting consignments for its inaugural Paris Auction, set for February 3, 2027, at the stunning Peninsula Paris Hotel during Rétromobile Week, as well as consignments for its return to Amelia Island as the official auction of The Amelia Concours on March 5-6, 2027.
Additional information on upcoming auctions is available at broadarrowauctions.com. Members of the media with any questions are invited to reach out to the Broad Arrow Press Team at

All prices are listed in USD and include buyer’s premium, which is equal to the sum of twelve percent (12%) of the first $250,000 of the Hammer Price and ten percent (10%) of the amount by which the Hammer Price exceeds $250,000 for all motor car lots.

Broad Arrow Auctions, driven by Hagerty

, is a leading global collector car auction house founded in 2021 by industry veterans. As the fastest-growing auction house in its segment, Broad Arrow connects exceptional collector cars with enthusiasts worldwide through flagship events including The Broad Arrow Quail Auction (the official auction of The Quail by The Peninsula, A Motorsports Gathering), The Amelia Auction (the official auction of The Amelia Concours), The Porsche Auction in collaboration with Air | Water by Luftgekühlt, the Las Vegas Auction in partnership with Concours at Wynn Las Vegas, as well as international auctions held in partnership with Concorso d’Eleganza Villa d’Este, Zoute Grand Prix, and Auto Zürich.
Learn more at broadarrowauctions.com and follow us on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter.

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers, protecting 2.8 million vehicles in the United States, Canada and the UK. We make it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love through innovative insurance products, live and digital auctions, engaging media and events, as well as the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest community of car lovers.
For more information, please visit www.hagerty.com or www.newsroom.hagerty.com.
